PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: final-policy executed residual is near zero; saturation 0
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Older diagnostics may contain nonzero residual
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: evaluate an explicitly chosen nonzero checkpoint

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: PPO residual is too small to change the FSM
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: residual_action_statistics.png and identical final outcomes
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Raw policy outputs are nonzero before phase/state projection
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: log gate occupancy and executed residual during training

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Actions are heavily clipped
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: episodes residual_saturation_rate=0; telemetry policy clip fraction ~0
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Phase gain has a hard clip but is rarely reached
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: retain saturation instrumentation

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Workspace projection removes wheel-center residual
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: runtime has no workspace projection; invalid IK falls back to baseline
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: The specialized action projection removes channels before IK
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: separately log action projection and IK fallback

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: IK branch or joint clipping breaks continuity
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: nearest-reference branch selection; canonical terminal IK invalid counts are zero
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Per-step joint target rate limiting can alter requested motion
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: log requested-vs-final wheel-center displacement

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Wheel-speed residual causes slip or collision
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: v34 final executed wheel-speed residual is effectively zero; FSM has same collision pattern
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Earlier v31-v33 diagnostics tested wheel corrections
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: only test under registered diagnostic label

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: PPO optimizes progress while ignoring support transfer
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: progress weight 8; Method B CoM weight 0; no training component telemetry
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: success, collision, phase-progress and top-contact terms exist
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: log per-term returns by phase

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Method B has no CoM reward, so stability improvement is not expected
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: ppo_without_com.yaml com_margin_weight=0.0
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: pitch/slip/tilt penalties still provide indirect stability incentives
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: evaluate Method C separately

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Method C training is not complete
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: seed 11 / 50 mm status=RUNNING, checkpoints=13, development_gate=False
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Method C has started but is not complete
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: monitor the externally owned run; evaluate only after a completed development gate

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Orchestration waits for Method B promote before Method C
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: run_until_success defaults ContinueAfterFailedDevelopmentGate=true and schedules C after B coverage
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Sequential scheduling still waits for B process completion
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: fix supervisor exit-code bug

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Method B failure incorrectly blocks Method C
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: failed gates are explicitly continued; supervisor attempt 3 proceeded to Method C
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: earlier supervisor attempts failed on an empty exit-code message
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: repair supervisor exit-code handling without interrupting the live run

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Training success proxy differs from formal success

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: environment success reward uses the same success buffer as evaluation
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: evaluate checkpoint candidates on development success

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: final gates are complete
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: run fixed 5-10 scenario diagnostic when no supervisor owns Isaac

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Curriculum restores only policy, not optimizer/normalizers

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: scheduler is not checkpointed

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: KLAdaptiveLR scheduler object resets

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: fixed schedule intentionally continues failed gates

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.evidence: executed wheel residual is zero and FSM has the same failures
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: FSM reference itself commands post-transfer drive
PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.recommended diagnostic: separate reference and residual wheel commands

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.counter-evidence: Some global timeouts may have different transient histories

PPO_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES.csv.hypothesis: Timeout exposes slow behavior rather than a bad timeout setting
